Quadrupedal_Barrel_Chassis.description: An immensely heavily built quadrupedal frame featuring a gigantic, barrel-shaped ribcage. It is specifically evolved to house truly massive multi-chambered fermentation stomachs required to digest cellulose-heavy grasses while granting unstoppable charging momentum.

Cursorial_Slender_Core.description: A highly elongated, laterally compressed frame built explicitly for breathtaking, sustained running speeds. The spine acts as a high-tension bow during full gallops, trading raw mass for sheer kinetic evasion from pursuit predators.
